title: Models Take Notes at Prefill: KV Cache Can Be Editable and Composable
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multimodal serving

problem_statement.en: Prefix caching reuses prefill only across an exactly shared prefix: one changed field (a timestamp, a user id, an order status) invalidates the entire downstream KV cache, yet surgically overwriting the field's own key/value vectors leaves the model acting on the old value. Agentic workloads with mutable fields and dynamically assembled contexts therefore pay repeated O(L^2) reprefill.
problem_statement.zh: Prefix caching 只能在完全相同的 prefix 上重用 prefill：只要其中一個欄位改變（如 timestamp、user id 或訂單狀態），整段下游 KV cache 即告失效；然而僅覆寫該欄位自身的 key/value 向量，模型仍會依舊值行動。因此帶有可變欄位與動態組裝 context 的 agentic 工作負載必須反覆支付 O(L^2) 的 reprefill 成本。

key_innovation.en: Causally establishes an attention-mediated memoized inference mechanism: at prefill the model already writes field-conditioned conclusions onto downstream aggregator tokens (the field's own KV drives under 1% of the decision), reframing the KV cache as a notebook of memoized conclusions. Two operations follow: an append-only erratum (or recompute of the affected downstream notes) that edits the cache, and RoPE-repositioned splicing of precompiled skill/memory/image KV chunks that composes caches in O(L) instead of O(L^2).
key_innovation.zh: 以因果實驗確立 attention-mediated memoized inference 機制：模型在 prefill 階段即把欄位條件化的結論寫入下游 aggregator token（欄位自身 KV 對決策的貢獻不到 1%），據此將 KV cache 重新定義為記錄既定結論的筆記本。由此衍生兩種操作：以 append-only erratum（或重算受影響的下游 notes）編輯 cache，以及透過 RoPE 重新定位拼接預編譯的 skill/memory/影像 KV 區塊，以 O(L) 而非 O(L^2) 完成組合。

baselines_compared: CacheBlend, ROME, LoRA fine-tuning, vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching

key_improvements.en: Unified edit+compose agent stays decision-identical to full recompute at up to 14.9x lower cumulative TTFT; skill transplant is O(L) vs O(L^2) (13.9x TTFT speedup at 32k tokens; logit cosine 0.90-0.999 across twelve models); in online vLLM serving the append-only erratum keeps a 98.5% vs 1.0% prefix-cache hit-rate, cutting p90 TTFT by 53-398x with throughput gains up to 14.5x at saturation.
key_improvements.zh: 統一的 edit+compose agent 與完整 recompute 決策一致，累計 TTFT 最多降低 14.9x；skill 移植為 O(L) 而非 O(L^2)（32k token 時 TTFT 加速 13.9x，十二個模型上 logit cosine 0.90–0.999）；線上 vLLM serving 中 append-only erratum 使 prefix cache 命中率維持 98.5%（基線僅 1.0%），p90 TTFT 降低 53–398x，飽和負載下吞吐量最高提升 14.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
